# mix_lorentz_berthelot { #mofography.data.mix_lorentz_berthelot }

```python
data.mix_lorentz_berthelot(
    ase_atoms,
    forcefield=forcefields['uff'],
    probe_symbol='He',
)
```

Mix framework and probe UFF parameters with Lorentz-Berthelot rules for each framework atom.

## Parameters {.doc-section .doc-section-parameters}

| Name         | Type   | Description                                                           | Default              |
|--------------|--------|-----------------------------------------------------------------------|----------------------|
| ase_atoms    |        | the atoms object from ASE                                             | _required_           |
| forcefield   |        | a dictionary of force field parameters for the atoms in the framework | `forcefields['uff']` |
| probe_symbol |        | the symbol of the probe atom, defaults to He (optional)               | `'He'`               |

## Returns {.doc-section .doc-section-returns}

| Name   | Type   | Description                                              |
|--------|--------|----------------------------------------------------------|
|        |        | The mixed sigma and epsilon values for the interactions. |
